use default

let names = ["up", "down", "left", "right"]
let row_steps = [-1, 1, 0, 0]
let column_steps = [0, 0, -1, 1]

let found = -1

distance(tile: int, at: int) -> int =>
    System.Math.abs(at / 4 - (tile - 1) / 4) +
    System.Math.abs(at % 4 - (tile - 1) % 4)

class SOLVER is
    _board: LIST[int]
    _blank: int
    _estimate: int
    _path: LIST[int]

    path: List[int] => _path

    init(tiles: int[]) is
        _board = LIST[int](tiles)
        _blank = _board.index_of(0)
        _path = LIST[int]()

        _estimate =
            tiles
                |> index()
                |> filter(t => t.value != 0)
                |> map(t => distance(t.value, t.index))
                |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a + b)
    si

    solve() is
        let bound mut = _estimate

        while bound != found do
            bound = _search(0, bound, -1)
        od
    si

    _search(depth: int, bound: int, last: int) -> int is
        let cost = depth + _estimate

        if cost > bound then
            return cost
        fi

        if _estimate == 0 then
            return found
        fi

        let next mut = int.max_value

        for move in 0..4 do
            let row = _blank / 4 + row_steps[move]
            let column = _blank % 4 + column_steps[move]

            if (last >= 0 /\ move == last ^ 1) \/
                row < 0 \/ row > 3 \/ column < 0 \/ column > 3
            then
                continue
            fi

            let from = _blank
            let target = row * 4 + column
            let tile = _board[target]
            let change = distance(tile, from) - distance(tile, target)

            _slide(target, from, tile, change, move)

            let result = _search(depth + 1, bound, move)

            if result == found then
                return found
            fi

            _slide(from, target, tile, -change, -1)

            if result < next then
                next = result
            fi
        od

        next
    si

    _slide(blank: int, tile_at: int, tile: int, change: int, move: int) is
        _board[tile_at] = tile
        _board[blank] = 0
        _blank = blank
        _estimate = _estimate + change

        if move >= 0 then
            _path.add(move)
        else
            _path.remove_at(_path.count - 1)
        fi
    si
si

let solver = SOLVER([
    15, 14,  1,  6,
     9, 11,  4, 12,
     0, 10,  7,  3,
    13,  8,  5,  2
])

solver.solve()

let moves = solver.path

write_line("solved in {moves.count} moves:")
write_line(moves |> map(m => names[m][0]) |> join(""))
write_line("")

for line in 0..(moves.count + 7) / 8 do
    write_line(
        moves
            |> skip(line * 8)
            |> take(8)
            |> map(m => names[m])
            |> join(", "))
od
